Implement live WYSIWYG editor with real-time markdown rendering

Implement live WYSIWYG editor with real-time markdown rendering

BREAKING CHANGE: Replace split edit/preview mode with unified WYSIWYG experience

## Major Changes:
- Add Tiptap WYSIWYG editor for live markdown rendering like Notion/Obsidian
- Remove problematic edit/preview tabs that disrupted user flow
- Fix auto-save UX - no longer throws users out of edit mode
- Implement real-time formatting as users type (bullets, headers, etc.)

## New Features:
- Live bullet points, headers, and formatting appear instantly while typing
- Native spell check, autocorrect, and auto-capitalization
- Apple system font integration for native feel
- Seamless image paste support with drag & drop
- Smart auto-save with visual indicators ('Unsaved changes', 'Saving...', 'Saved HH:MM:SS')
- Auto-focus for new notes, maintains focus during editing

## Technical Implementation:
- WysiwygEditor.tsx: New Tiptap-based editor component
- Replaced Textarea + ReactMarkdown preview with unified editor
- Enhanced typography with prose classes and custom styling
- Improved dark mode support throughout editor
- Better empty states and loading indicators

## UX Improvements:
- No more jarring transitions between edit/preview modes
- Continuous editing experience like modern note-taking apps
- Visual feedback for save states without interrupting flow
- Maintains cursor position and focus during auto-saves
- Word count updates in real-time

This addresses the core user feedback about wanting to see formatting
results immediately while typing, similar to Apple Notes/Notion experience.
